notes: Starter mission library for Intel Pet. This file is intentionally small and hand-authored.
Full mission text and exact reward data should be imported only from a source whose license and attribution are recorded.
EVE mission ISK, LP, bonus, and standing outcomes can vary by agent, system, skills, and server-side balancing.

missions.title: The Blood-Stained Stars
missions.mission_giver: Sister Alitura / Sisters of EVE Epic Arc Agents
missions.objective_text: Follow the Sisters of EVE epic arc chain and complete each offered objective in sequence.
completion_steps: Accept the current epic arc mission from the active arc agent.
Read the in-game objective for the current step before undocking.
Travel to the listed destination, complete the combat, delivery, or conversation objective, then return or report as instructed.
Use the final branch choice carefully because the standing reward depends on the faction selected.
missions.completion_notes: This starter entry summarizes the arc. Exact step objectives should come from the in-game agent offer or a licensed mission import.
missions.briefing_text: A Sisters of EVE arc briefing. The pet knows this as a high-level local reference only; read the in-game agent window for the exact current objective before accepting or undocking.
standing_rewards: Faction standing reward varies by final arc choice
missions.bonus_isk_reward: Varies by mission step and completion time
missions.reward_notes: Use this starter entry for voice/browser testing, not payout planning.

missions.title: Cash Flow for Capsuleers
missions.objective_text: Complete the military career-agent combat lesson currently offered in the chain.
completion_steps: Accept the career-agent step.
Fit the provided or recommended beginner combat equipment.
Warp to the mission location, destroy or interact with the requested targets, then return to the agent.
Check the in-game mission journal for exact target names and delivery requirements.
missions.completion_notes: Career-agent steps vary by empire faction and mission number.
missions.briefing_text: A military career agent sends the pilot through early combat lessons. The local library keeps only a safe summary until source-backed briefing text is imported.
standing_rewards: Career-agent standing changes vary by agent and character
item_rewards: Career-agent ships, modules, or ammunition can vary by faction and step
missions.reward_notes: Verify exact reward values in the in-game agent window.

missions.title: Balancing the Books
missions.objective_text: Complete the business career-agent lesson for hauling, trading, or market basics.
completion_steps: Accept the business career-agent step.
Collect, buy, haul, or deliver the requested item shown in the in-game objective.
Use the destination in the mission journal rather than guessing from memory.
Return to the agent and complete the step once the required item or task is satisfied.
missions.completion_notes: Exact items and route details vary by faction and step.
missions.briefing_text: A business career agent introduces hauling, markets, and practical capsuleer commerce. The pet summary is only a local reference; use the agent offer for the exact task.
standing_rewards: Career-agent standing changes vary by agent and character
item_rewards: Business career item rewards vary by faction and step
missions.reward_notes: Reward values are intentionally marked variable until source-backed data is imported.

missions.title: Making Mountains of Molehills
missions.objective_text: Complete the industry career-agent production, mining, or delivery lesson currently offered.
completion_steps: Accept the industry career-agent step.
Mine, manufacture, refine, or haul the required item shown in the mission journal.
Wait for any manufacturing job to finish before trying to complete the mission.
Deliver the required item to the agent or destination listed in game.
missions.completion_notes: Blueprint, material, and item requirements vary by faction and mission step.
missions.briefing_text: An industry career agent walks the pilot through mining, manufacturing, and basic production flow. Exact minerals, items, and rewards should come from the in-game mission offer or a licensed mission data import.
standing_rewards: Career-agent standing changes vary by agent and character
item_rewards: Industry materials, blueprints, or ships can vary by faction and step

missions.title: A Case of Kidnapping
missions.objective_text: Run the security encounter and satisfy the agent's listed combat objective.
completion_steps: Accept the mission and review the in-game objective.
Fit an appropriate combat ship for a level 1 encounter.
Warp to the mission pocket and destroy the hostile NPCs or recover the requested item.
Return to the agent when the journal marks the objective complete.
missions.completion_notes: This starter entry is generic; exact pocket behavior should come from a licensed mission report or the live agent window.
missions.briefing_text: A security agent sends the pilot into a small combat encounter. This starter text is a safe local summary, not a copied agent briefing.
standing_rewards: Agent and corporation standing changes vary
